current_behavior: Pixel/display change invalidates dimensions, geometry, semantic, focal, safe-crop and thumbnails.
reason: Producer and tests agree.
resolved_contract: All crop authority is bound to current immutable pixel identity.

current_behavior: resolveEventImageCrop solves a target-aspect window over current protected regions and returns contain if they do not fit.
reason: Exact algorithm is tested and reusable.
resolved_contract: Use as deterministic primitive; its contain veto is authoritative wherever a profile invokes protected geometry.

current_behavior: The solver is called but a contain result is rewritten to cover.
reason: Current code converts a safety veto into telemetry only.
resolved_contract: Preserve solver fit; never convert its protected-regions-do-not-fit result into cover.

current_behavior: Mobile and desktop hero/gallery deliberately cover visual_only assets without the protected solver.
reason: Two current normative authorities conflict.
resolved_contract: Keep as explicit conflict-open consumer profile; do not promote to core or claim crop safety.

current_behavior: Most manual overrides bind mutable legacy URL/sourcePage rather than exact current pixels.
reason: Mutable identity reintroduces pixel drift.
resolved_contract: Require immutable p/image/v2 identity or exact source SHA; sourcePage alone cannot identify pixels.

current_behavior: Caller excludes visual_only while helper only accepts visual_only photo-like media.
reason: Current condition is logically unreachable and test is source-text-only.
resolved_contract: Evaluate the quality helper for admitted visual photos and emit an explicit bounded/contain action.

current_behavior: Semantic error becomes unknown/protected.
reason: Consumers agree on fail-closed semantic error.
resolved_contract: Keep error and unknown protected; no orientation-based promotion.

current_behavior: Classified safe focal event photo uses 140x112 cover; protected media contains within 62..199x112.
reason: Exact local geometry and cardinality are source-backed.
resolved_contract: Keep only in profile.mobile-listing-rail-row; never use 5:4 as a global frame default.

current_behavior: Regular/weekend/popular use 1.35/1.20/1.25 visual targets, protected natural ratio and quality thresholds.
reason: Different density geometry is intentional consumer policy.
resolved_contract: Keep three explicit listing profiles and their local source-quality actions.

current_behavior: Weak photo is hidden only when a stronger same-event alternative exists; documents remain.
reason: Selection is event-local and semantically bounded.
resolved_contract: Keep asset selection separate from presentation/crop.

current_behavior: Code/comments imply no silent upscale but accepted policy permits bounded 300x174 to 221px display.
reason: Claim and accepted behavior differ.
resolved_contract: Emit a numeric profile-local max-scale or explicit allowed bounded scale; never claim universal no-upscale.

current_behavior: Broken image is hidden and semantic fallback remains while geometry is stable.
reason: This is the strongest current reusable recovery behavior.
resolved_contract: Expose loaded/loading/broken/missing as explicit frame outcomes.

current_behavior: Error clears the skeleton but leaves broken image UI and no semantic fallback.
reason: Current error handler is incomplete.
resolved_contract: Hide failed image and show profile-defined semantic fallback while retaining geometry.

current_behavior: Metadata calls protected media natural but deck CSS covers every image.
reason: Renderer contradicts its own treatment record.
resolved_contract: Protected/nonvisual rows must contain/source-preserve; safe visual cover remains deck-local.

current_behavior: Aggregate visual_only is center-covered into 1080x1350 without current safe/focal evidence or scale ceiling.
reason: Output pipeline bypasses media safety inputs.
resolved_contract: Require immutable asset identity and explicit share-output profile crop/scale evidence; protected assets pass through.

current_behavior: Aggregate visual_only covers an arbitrary flex frame using focal Y only.
reason: Current aggregate gate lacks role, safety and current-pixel provenance.
resolved_contract: Require classified asset-local eligibility and explicit failure recovery; otherwise contain.

current_behavior: Desktop CSS forces document shells near square and clips/overflows them.
reason: Legacy path contradicts protected-natural requirement.
resolved_contract: Use optimized related/mobile profile and source-preserving document geometry.

current_behavior: Viewport-cover parent CSS can force every thumbnail to cover including OCR/document.
reason: CSS authority currently bypasses per-asset semantics.
resolved_contract: Apply per-asset frame decisions; parent composition cannot override internal fit.

current_behavior: Missing width/height is exported as invented 1080x1350.
reason: Fabricated dimensions contaminate later geometry decisions.
resolved_contract: Preserve unknown dimensions and use decode-natural/profile reservation without asserting source ratio.

current_behavior: Lab-only responsive-target-unknown contain fixture.
reason: No production consumer exists.
resolved_contract: Retain only as evidence fixture, not production policy.

current_behavior: Lab-only component blindly covers OCR/doc thumbnails.
reason: Only design-system lab imports it.
resolved_contract: Exclude from production component materialization and profile closure.
